runtime_code_note: The baseline arm was already running when CPC integration was merged. Traces capture config but no runtime source hash; code hashes below describe the collection-time checkout, not proof of every loaded runtime revision.
input: small-v2; one_pass=true; private=false; 55 fixed synthetic scenarios
privacy: No audio, transcripts, reply text, or private recordings in this artifact.

interpretation.quantiles: summary uses existing report._pct: sorted[round(q*(n-1))]; p50 for n=10 is lower middle, not arithmetic median
interpretation.latency_breakdown: Existing approximate script; standard statistics.median, separate component medians need not sum to total. deliver subtracts engine audio_s from bench arrival t, can be negative, and is not measured transport latency. First audio matching is time-based, not generation-based.
interpretation.trace_lag: trace wall-clock t minus prediction at_s; includes connection clock offset; audio_s-at_s is NOT the wall-clock lag
interpretation.T5: Short segments can include interrupted main replies. Explicit backchannel sends are counted separately. Diagnostic clip envelopes use retained playback after stop, approximate sample placement from rounded timestamps; before/after turn classes are playback-start times.
interpretation.traces: Sequential trace files matched to sorted scenario IDs, 55 per repetition; current queue uses --jobs 1. Pairing additionally checks complete STT text and stop generation sequences in memory; no text is exported.

diagnostic.limitations: Replay from rounded event timestamps, using Player queue and stop rules. Counts classify retained envelope playback starts, not send times. Envelopes may include silence or be shortened by stop. Stopped reply generations count stop notifications, not confirmed audible cuts. Not a new listening-quality measurement.
